text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hmm-hm-hmm! ♪ I've got me some<n>training today!
...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
We're about to throw a party. You<n>can join in if
you'd like, Taiki!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Of course, I—I would... if didn't I have<n>training today.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Oh... And we even ordered in an<n>extra-large pizza,
too. Welp, if you<n>can't make it, that's fine!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
But... it's not like my training starts<n>right this
second. I think I can slot this<n>in...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text: Are you sure you're okay on time?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, no problem! C'mon, let's get<n>this party
started!
